migrations.bridge: NetBird management/control plane remains authoritative until Conduit Control state and orchestration are accepted
migrations.retirement_condition: Conduit Control is authoritative for required management state and rollback to the previously accepted state is proven

migrations.bridge: Conduit API compatibility adapters preserve required NetBird API behavior while first-party contracts are introduced
migrations.retirement_condition: All required GoreeCloud consumers use accepted Conduit API contracts and compatibility coverage proves no required behavior is lost

migrations.bridge: Existing peer/device records remain authoritative while Conduit Devices models and import/export behavior are developed
migrations.retirement_condition: Device identity, ownership, approval, revocation, and lifecycle state migrate without loss and recovery is proven

migrations.bridge: Existing user and service-user network references remain authoritative until Conduit Principals is accepted
migrations.retirement_condition: Required principal relationships migrate intact while GoreeCloud Identity boundaries remain preserved

migrations.bridge: Existing NetBird groups remain authoritative while Conduit Groups gains equivalent purpose-based membership behavior
migrations.retirement_condition: Group membership and policy references migrate without broadening access

migrations.bridge: NetBird access policies remain enforcement authority until Conduit Access passes deny-by-default and least-privilege equivalence tests
migrations.retirement_condition: Conduit Access enforces all approved policy semantics without unintended reachability expansion

migrations.bridge: Existing posture conditions remain authoritative while Conduit Posture models and evaluation semantics are implemented
migrations.retirement_condition: Required posture conditions and policy dependencies migrate and fail safely

migrations.bridge: Existing private resources/networks remain authoritative while Conduit Resources introduces first-party models
migrations.retirement_condition: Hosts, subnets, domains, networks, and resource relationships migrate without reachability drift

migrations.bridge: Existing route and routing-peer behavior remains active while Conduit Routes is characterized and validated
migrations.retirement_condition: Conduit Routes preserves approved routing, failover, site-to-site, and clientless paths under failure and rollback tests

migrations.bridge: Existing setup-key and enrollment flows remain available while Conduit Enrollment introduces first-party credential lifecycle behavior
migrations.retirement_condition: Enrollment, approval, revocation, recovery, and replacement-device workflows pass controlled acceptance

migrations.bridge: NetBird signal service remains required until Conduit Signal protocol behavior is characterized and implemented
migrations.retirement_condition: Conduit Signal establishes required peer/session coordination reliably across accepted scenarios

migrations.bridge: NetBird relay service remains required until Conduit Relay discovery, selection, health, and failover are accepted
migrations.retirement_condition: Conduit Relay provides reliable relayed connectivity and failover without weakening privacy or access controls

migrations.bridge: Inherited NAT traversal and direct/relayed path orchestration remains active until Conduit Path is accepted
migrations.retirement_condition: Conduit Path reliably selects and reports approved direct/relayed paths across representative networks

migrations.bridge: Inherited Network-side DNS distribution remains active while Conduit DNS Delivery is implemented behind the Beacon authority boundary
migrations.retirement_condition: Conduit DNS Delivery distributes approved resolver state without assuming Beacon DNS-service authority

migrations.bridge: Inherited event/audit presentation remains available while Conduit Activity introduces first-party privacy-conscious records and presentation
migrations.retirement_condition: Required Network history and security-relevant events are preserved with approved retention and redaction behavior

migrations.bridge: Inherited diagnostics remain available as a recovery path while Conduit Diagnostics expands local-first, redacted evidence collection
migrations.retirement_condition: Conduit Diagnostics covers required support evidence without unnecessary remote telemetry or secret leakage

migrations.bridge: NetBird dashboard behavior remains a compatibility reference while Conduit Console progressively replaces administrative product surfaces
migrations.retirement_condition: All required administrative workflows are available in accepted Glaze UI surfaces without dependence on the inherited dashboard

migrations.bridge: Inherited Android networking core remains available beneath the GoreeCloud product layer until Conduit Android completes signed and real-device acceptance
migrations.retirement_condition: Conduit Android passes signed provenance, enrollment, connectivity, recovery, and real-device acceptance against the accepted control plane

migrations.bridge: Existing compatible desktop clients remain available while Conduit Desktop requirements are characterized
migrations.retirement_condition: Required desktop platforms have accepted GoreeCloud-controlled client behavior or an explicitly approved retained client dependency

migrations.bridge: Existing compatible Apple client path remains available while Conduit Apple is planned after control-plane and Android stabilization
migrations.retirement_condition: Accepted GoreeCloud Apple clients cover required enrollment, connectivity, recovery, and release behavior

migrations.bridge: Inherited build/release assumptions remain reference inputs while Conduit Release establishes GoreeCloud provenance, packaging, signing, update, and rollback contracts
migrations.retirement_condition: GoreeCloud-controlled release pipelines produce verifiable artifacts with documented update and rollback behavior
